author: Jérémy Rosen
name: save_selection
description: Provides keyboard shortcuts to save the current image selection into and restore it from several temporary buffers, plus a quick-swap buffer.
description-extensive: This tool lets you stash your current set of selected photos into memory slots and bring them back later with a keyboard shortcut. You get several buffers plus a quick-swap option, which is useful when juggling different groups of images while sorting or editing. No extra software is required.
